A fraction 0.2 is reflected; of the absorbed photons, 0.1 produce one collected electron each. The photocurrent charges an initially uncharged capacitor 10 μF for 2 s; an ideal collection arrangement maintains that constant current. Take ε0=8.85×10⁻¹² F/m, c=3×10⁸ m/s, h=6.63×10⁻³⁴ J s and e=1.6×10⁻¹⁹ C. Find the stored capacitor energy then. Choose the closest value.
